recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source change is needed for FHIR-17143 unless a future pharmacy decision requests a separate editorial cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-17143 was a Published pharm technical correction with a Persuasive with Modification resolution asking to update the MedicationRequest status code `draft` definition from the older `i.e.` wording that combined sign-off/verification with `and needs to be run through decision support process` to wording using `e.g.` and treating sign-off, verification, or decision-support processing as alternatives.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was applied in old SVN build history. Git-svn commit e880d7aefcd50da109830288c2be9b4f5746d923 explicitly lists tracker 17143 and changed `source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-spreadsheet.xml` from the old `i.e.` / `and needs` text to the accepted `e.g.` / `verification or needs` text. Later commit 7373e742ee4ae5907dc0d8b0779cadb0cb0892f0 split the MedicationRequest status codelist into `source/medicationrequest/codesystem-medicationrequest-status.xml` with that changed draft definition.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in `source/fhir.ini`, so the MedicationRequest CodeSystem file is current build-scope source. Later refactoring preserved the resolved wording while changing `prescription` to `request`, which aligns with current MedicationRequest terminology and does not reverse the FHIR-17143 decision. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because `source/medicationrequest/codesystem-medicationrequest-status.xml` already says the request is not yet actionable, uses `e.g.`, and lists sign-off, verification, or decision-support processing as alternatives.
